apiKey.keyFor: your own AI endpoint and key, and some text-to-speech services (OpenAI, MiniMax, Supertone)
apiKey.worksWithout: LingKuma default free AI (leave the Base URL blank)

evidence.quote: Leave blank to use LingKuma default free AI
The plugin switches to your own API only when a custom Base URL is entered. Leave it blank to continue using the default service ported from LingKuma.

checkNote: The pack quotes 'Leave it blank to continue using the default service ported from LingKuma.', so default AI works without a key. A custom Base URL is possible, but the only localhost use is port 2333 for subtitle clipping, which is not AI. No evidence of local AI models, so unknown.
